narrative.details:
<The little slime seems delighted and is attempting to mirror your motions as you dance. It begins to look weary though.

The little slime hovers over a bit of sludge and absorbs it, looking slightly rejuvenated.

It seems all of this dancing has tuckered it out. Perhaps someone in the Undercity canals sells more of this nutritious sludge?>
narrative.objectives: Purchase Nutritious Slime Sludge and return to your befriended excitable slime. If it seems tired, try dancing with it again to catch its attention.
narrative.offerRewardText: <The slime shudders with newfound energy. It seems to want to follow you, now that it has associated you with food.>
narrative.requestItemsText: <The slime seems to regard you with interest.>

mentionedItems.name: Nutritious Slime Sludge
tooltip: Use: Restores 10 health over 15 sec. Must remain seated while eating.
